- Confirmed list of deliverables for first 90 days (onboarding milestones).

Hi Maya —

Great to hear the demo resonated. I put together a short decision matrix and a vendor onboarding timeline draft (see attachments). Quick answers up front:

- Onboarding milestones: kickoff, security review handoff, pilot (2 weeks), validation run(1 week), production cutover.
- Invoicing/PO: we accept PO + Net30 as standard. We can invoice monthly or milestone-based per the PO.
- Data retention: Redacted request logs kept for 90 days by default; longer retention on request and within Private deployments.
- Security docs: SOC 2 Type II report + pen-test summary available; I attached a checklist for what to expect.

I also included "vendor-questions-finquest.xlsx" with fields Procurement usually requests filled out — please confirm and I can complete the company-side answers.

Action items I propose:
1) FinQuest to confirm economic buyer and target PO owner.
2) Procurement to share required legal clauses (if any non-standard).
3) We schedule a 30-min procurement sprint next week to walk the checklist.

Who is the right person on your side for the economic buyer? If you prefer, I can label approvers as Technical, Finance, Legal in the matrix and you can update names.

Best,

Thanks for the quick coordination. Finalizing next steps here so everyone has a single source of truth:

- Completed vendor-questions-finquest.xlsx (Rishi) — filled answers for SOC2, data retention, support SLAs.

Decision matrix (short):

- Finance / PO Owner: Emily Sanders — issues PO and validates billing terms.
- Security: Tyler Wu — approves SOC2/pen-test evidence and any technical safeguards.

2) Redlines returned (1–5 business days).
